DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 窓口を来週予約しましたが、この書類の期限は今週と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約日より早い書類期限を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I booked the counter for next week, but this document says the deadline is this week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a document deadline earlier than the appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約したのは、提出のためですか、説明を聞くためですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the appointment for submission or for an explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 説明を聞くためです。予約があるから提出期限も延びると思い込んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 説明予約で提出期限延長と誤解したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: For an explanation. I assumed having an appointment also extended the submission deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook an explanatory appointment for a deadline extension. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 期限の扱いを担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check how the deadline is handled with the responsible staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。まだ書類は出していません。準備できている分を先に出せるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未提出と準備済み分の先提出を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I have not submitted the documents yet. I also want to ask whether I can submit the completed parts first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say nothing is submitted and ask about submitting prepared parts first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 未記入の項目はどこですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 添付資料の欄です。資料が必要か分からず、空欄にしてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明な添付欄を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The attachments field. I left it blank because I do not know whether supporting documents are required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the unclear attachments field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類を持って担当へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take the documents and consult the responsible staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。期限と予約日を示し、未記入欄と提出方法を今日確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付と未記入箇所を持参し今日確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will show the deadline and appointment date and check the blank field and submission method today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bring the dates and incomplete sections and check today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで担当へ引き継ぎます。予約によって期限が変わるとは、まだ判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will refer you to the responsible staff member. Do not yet assume the appointment changes the deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の説明で、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have questions about the test instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 食事についての部分を聞き取れませんでした。分かったふりをせず、もう一度聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食事指示を聞き取れず再説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I could not catch the part about meals. Rather than pretend I understood, I would like to hear it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the meal instructions to be explained again because you did not catch them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分が曖昧ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝食を食べないのか、飲み物も全部だめなのかが分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝食と飲物条件の疑問を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not know whether to skip breakfast or whether all drinks are also prohibited.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate your questions about breakfast and drinks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査ごとの指示を担当から説明してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will have the responsible staff member explain instructions for your particular test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。ほかの人の検査と同じ条件だとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 検査ごとに条件確認が必要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I do not assume the conditions are the same as someone else's test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the conditions need checking for each test. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当日の薬についても相談しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you also like advice about medication that day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、毎朝飲む薬があります。自分で中止せず、薬の名前を見せて担当へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 常用薬を示し自己中止せず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I take medication every morning. I will not stop it myself, but show the name and ask the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your regular medicine and seek advice instead of stopping it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 指示をメモしておくと確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check the instructions by writing them down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモします。食事、飲み物、薬を別々に書き、最後に私の理解が合っているか読んで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三項目をメモして復唱確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will write meals, drinks and medicine separately, then read them back to check my understanding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write the three items down and ask to confirm them by reading them back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その方法で担当へご相談ください。検査名とお薬の情報をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consult the staff member that way. Bring the test name and your medication information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の確認資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have documents to identify the bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。登録の名前は旧姓です。今の在留カードとは名字が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 登録旧姓と現在名の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is registered in my former surname, which differs from the surname on my current residence card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the former registered surname and your current name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 登録名と現在名がつながる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have documents linking the registered and current names?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は持っていません。名前が違うだけで、別人の自転車とは言えないと思い相談しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名前のつながりの資料を今日は持たないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not with me today. I am asking because I do not think a different name alone proves it is someone else's bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you do not have the documents linking the names today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで確認方法を担当へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask the responsible staff member how to verify this.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で札を書き換えず、必要な資料を準備したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 札を自己変更せず必要資料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not rewrite the tag myself; I want to prepare the necessary documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about documents without changing the tag yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入した時期は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know when you bought it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 去年です。領収書は家にあり、登録番号もそこに残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入時期と自宅領収書を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Last year. The receipt is at home, and the registration number is recorded there too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain when you bought it and that the receipt is at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず番号と資料を整理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: First organize the number and documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。旧姓、現在名、登録番号が分かる資料を集め、更新が必要かも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前と番号の資料を整理し更新要否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will gather documents showing the former surname, current name and registration number, and ask whether an update is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize name and number documents and ask if updating is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その情報を担当へお伝えください。確認が済むまで登録の表示は変更しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please give that information to the staff member. Do not change the displayed registration until verification is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再配達の変更でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you changing a redelivery booking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今夜の時間帯を予約しましたが、急に仕事が入り家にいられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再配達予約時間に不在となると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I booked a time slot tonight, but unexpected work means I cannot be at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you will be absent during the booked redelivery slot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更はもう操作されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already made the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。家族が受け取るとも決まっていないので、元の時間のままにはしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未変更と家族受取も未確定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. It is not certain that family can receive it either, so I do not want to leave the original time unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the booking is unchanged and family receipt is also uncertain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号を使って変更できる方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check how to change it using the reference number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。明日の夜なら在宅できますが、その時間が選べるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在宅可能な翌夜の選択可否を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I can be home tomorrow night, but want to know whether that slot is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether tomorrow night's slot, when you can be home, can be selected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 選択できる時間帯を担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the available slots with the responsible staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。希望と確定した時間を分けて、家族にも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望と確定時間を分けて家族へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will distinguish my requested time from the confirmed time when telling my family too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your family which time is requested and which is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約完了の表示は確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you check the booking-completed display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更できたら表示を保存します。電話で希望を話しただけで、変更完了とは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 完了表示を保存し希望連絡だけで済ませないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: If the change goes through, I will save the display. I will not assume merely requesting it by phone completes the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will save the completed display and not rely only on requesting the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 票の番号をお見せください。選べる時間と完了確認の方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the number on the notice. We will explain available slots and how to verify completion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 残高のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about your balance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は給与の日です。振込予定の金額を足せば、この支払いができると思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与予定を含めた支払可能性を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Today is payday. I think I can make this payment if I include the expected salary transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about ability to pay including expected wages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の入金記録は確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked the current deposit record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ入っていません。予定日と、もう入金されたことは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未入金で予定と実績を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It has not arrived yet. The scheduled date and an actual completed deposit are different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish a scheduled deposit from an actual one while nothing has arrived. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでは会社の支払い予定までは確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot confirm your company's payment schedule here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。会社へ振込状況を確認し、今の残高だけで払えるか見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社への状況確認と現残高の再検討を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will check the transfer status with my company and review whether the current balance alone covers it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check with the company and reconsider using the present balance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 支払いの期限はいつですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日です。相手への相談が必要かも含めて、自分で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日の期限と相手先相談の必要を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today. I will check myself, including whether I need to consult the payee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain today's deadline and the possible need to consult the payee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録の見方はご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can explain how to read the record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。未入金を残高へ足さず、入金記録が出てから金額を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入金記録確認後に金額照合すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will not add an unpaid deposit to the balance; I will match the amount after the deposit record appears.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will match the amount after checking the deposit record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現在の記録はこちらです。入金予定については会社へ、支払い期限は相手先へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the current record. Ask your company about the expected deposit and the payee about the payment deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った果物の箱で、一個が傷んでいました。一個だけ交換できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱内一個の傷みと部分交換可否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: One piece of fruit in a box bought yesterday was spoiled. I want to ask whether just that one can be exchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about one spoiled item in a box and a partial exchange. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱と購入の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the box and purchase record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。残りの果物も箱に入っています。傷んだ一個は、分かるよう別の袋にしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱購入記録と別袋にした一個を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The remaining fruit is still in the box. I put the spoiled piece in a separate bag so it is identifiable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the box, purchase record and separately bagged item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 売場担当が状態と対応を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The sales staff will check its condition and the available response.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。傷んだ物を売場の箱へ戻したり、自分で別の一個を取ったりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 売場へ自己返却交換しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not put the spoiled item back into a sales box or take another piece myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not return or exchange items in the sales area yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご購入後の保存はどうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: How did you store it after purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰宅後は表示に沿って保存しました。買った時刻と家までの時間も伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保存方法と購入後の時間を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I followed the label after arriving home. I can also explain the purchase time and travel time home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain storage and the time after purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちの箱を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us inspect the box you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。交換か返金かを先に決めつけず、担当の説明を聞いて選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対応説明を聞いてから交換返金を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not assume exchange or refund in advance; I will listen to the staff explanation before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose exchange or refund after hearing the available response. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 箱と記録をお預かりします。傷んだ一個を分けた状態で担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the box and record. Please show the staff the spoiled item kept separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for an exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつも川沿いから帰りますが、今日は道に水がたまっています。別の出口はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冠水した帰路と別出口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I usually return along the river, but water has collected on the path today. Is there another exit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a flooded return route and another exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 道路側の出口があります。お帰りの方向はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is an exit on the road side. Which direction are you heading home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅の方です。水の中を通って近道するのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅方向で水の中の近道を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Toward the station. I want to avoid taking a shortcut through the water.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are heading to the station and want to avoid a shortcut through water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 道路側へは、舗装された通路を使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use a paved passage to the road side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その通路を教えてください。川側の出口が開いているだけで、先まで通れるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開門と通行可能性を区別して経路を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please show it to me. I do not assume the path beyond the river-side gate is passable just because the gate is open.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish an open gate from a passable route and ask the way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この分かれ道を右へ進んでください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右ですね。途中でまた水があれば、先へ無理に進まず引き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 右経路を復唱し再冠水なら戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Right, understood. If I encounter more water, I will turn back rather than force my way onward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the right-hand route and say you will return if it is flooded again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご同行の方はいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 後ろから友人が来ます。出口を変えたことを今知らせ、川沿いへ向かわないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 後着の友人へ出口変更を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend is coming behind me. I will tell them about the changed exit now so they do not head along the river.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell the friend arriving later about the changed exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 右の通路で道路側へ出られます。足元を確認しながらお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The right-hand passage leads to the road side. Please watch your footing as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車の時刻を確認されますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。携帯に保存した時刻で来ましたが、今日はその列車が表示されていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保存時刻と表示の不一致を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I came using a timetable saved on my phone, but that train is not displayed today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the mismatch between a saved time and today's display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保存した表は平日用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the saved timetable for weekdays?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 平日と書いてあります。今日は休日なので、見る欄を間違えたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 平日表を休日に見たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says weekdays. Today is a holiday, so I seem to have looked at the wrong section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you used a weekday timetable on a holiday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 休日の欄で行き先を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the destination in the holiday section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。同じ時刻が載っていても、行き先まで同じとは考えずに見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休日表の行先も確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Even if the same time appears, I will not assume the destination is identical.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the destination on the holiday timetable too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 何時までに着きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: By what time do you want to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昼までです。休日の列車で間に合うか、乗換えも合わせて確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着希望時刻と接続確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: By noon. I would like to check whether holiday trains get me there in time, including transfers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your desired arrival time and ask to check connections. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この表の時刻と接続を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the times and connections in this timetable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。休日の表を保存し直し、前の画像と混ぜないよう日付も付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休日表を保存し日付で旧画像と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will save the holiday timetable again and label it with a date to avoid mixing it up with the old image.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Save the holiday timetable with a date to distinguish it from the old image. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 行き先と日付を確認してお使いください。今日は休日の案内に沿ってご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the destination and date when using it. Prepare according to today's holiday information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記入のお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help filling this in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に日本語を手伝ってもらっています。連絡先に友人の番号を書いてよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の番号を連絡先に使えるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend is helping with Japanese. I want to check whether I may use their number as the contact number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a friend's phone number can be used as the contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申請するのは、ご本人ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、私です。友人は書き方を手伝うだけで、申請者になるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人申請と記入補助の友人を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My friend only helps with writing and is not becoming the applicant.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish yourself as applicant from your friend as writing assistant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡できる方の扱いを担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the rules for contact persons with the responsible staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私の名前の欄へ、友人の名前を代わりに書くことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人名欄を友人名に変えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not put my friend's name in the field for my own name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not replace your name with your friend's in your name field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の電話は使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you use your own phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使えますが、電話の日本語が苦手です。文字で連絡を受ける方法があれば聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人電話はあり文字連絡希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, but spoken Japanese on the phone is difficult for me. I want to ask whether written contact is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have your own phone and prefer written contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用できる方法も担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us also check which methods are available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。本人の番号を基本にし、友人へ連絡してよい範囲も説明を聞いて決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人番号と友人連絡の範囲を確認して決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will primarily use my number and decide the permitted scope of contact with my friend after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your own number and the permitted scope of contact with your friend before deciding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申請者と補助する友人を分けて、担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consult the staff member while distinguishing the applicant from the friend providing assistance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 腕の痛みはいつからですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: When did the arm pain begin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の仕事中からです。重い物を持つ仕事ですが、どの動作で痛んだかも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発症時期と仕事動作を説明したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: During work yesterday. My job involves lifting heavy objects, but I also want to explain the exact movement that hurt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to explain onset and the work movement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その時の動作を教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 箱を棚へ上げた時です。普段は腰の高さですが、昨日は肩より高い棚でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱上げと普段との差を具体的に述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It happened when lifting a box onto a shelf. Usually the shelf is waist-high, but yesterday it was above my shoulders.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe lifting the box and the difference from usual. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 痛むのは左右どちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is it the left or right side that hurts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右です。仕事全体が原因と断定せず、痛みが出た時の状況として説明しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 右側の痛みと原因未断定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Right. I am describing the circumstances when the pain began, not concluding that my work as a whole caused it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain right-sided pain without asserting a definite cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今はどの動作で痛みますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右腕を上げると痛みます。安静にしている時の痛みは少ないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在痛む動作と安静時との差を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Raising my right arm hurts. There is less pain at rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the movement that hurts now and the difference at rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 服用した薬はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ飲んでいません。仕事へ戻る前に、診察で今の状態と作業について相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未服薬と復帰前の診察相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. Before returning to work, I want to discuss my present condition and duties during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say no medicine has been taken and ask for consultation before returning to work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 動作と左右の情報を記録します。診察で作業内容も詳しくお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will record the movement and side. Please also explain your duties in detail during the consultation.
